summary: Implements a client-side paste-cleaning utility and wires it into several text entry points (title, search, category inputs, and the rich-text editor paste handler). Also hardens HTML sanitization to drop comments/unsafe tags before rendering. However, numbered-list preservation in the HTML fallback path and evidence of coverage for *all* editable text surfaces are incomplete.

missing_requirements.requirement: Preserve numbered lists (e.g., "1.", "2.") when cleaning Word/HTML paste while removing Word HTML/CSS/comment junk.
missing_requirements.reason: In the HTML fallback path, all <li> elements are prefixed with a bullet character ("• ") regardless of whether the source list is ordered (<ol>) or unordered (<ul>), so numbering is not preserved when only text/html is available.

missing_requirements.requirement: Apply paste-cleaning behavior to every user-editable text entry surface in the app (including any other editable fields beyond title/search/category/editor).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows paste handlers added for title, search, new category name, and category rename, plus the rich text editor. The diff summary does not provide evidence that *all other* user-editable fields across the app are covered.
evidence: frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEditorDialog.tsx (title onPaste only; no evidence of other fields)
frontend/src/components/categories/ManageCategoriesDialog.tsx (onPaste added for rename input; truncated, unknown for other inputs)

hallucinated_features.description: Sanitizer explicitly preserves text color styling on <span> elements (inline color extraction from style/color).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-3 only requires preserving the editor’s allowed basic formatting (bold/italic and line breaks) while preventing Word/unsafe nodes from rendering. Color preservation is not requested in the BuildRequest.
evidence: frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeHtml.ts (allowedTags includes 'span'; preserves element.style.color / parses 'color:' from style attr)
